result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 4.29% (18.33% vs 14.04%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Flexi Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.63 vs benchmark 1.13, Sortino 2.25.
Defensive profile: beta 0.60 with 24% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 10.78% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.16).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -18.00% vs benchmark -34.16%.
Rolling return range spans 13.52% to 21.17% (7.65 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
